description: Save a job search as an email alert (seeker key, Basic verified). Sends NEW matching jobs daily or weekly to the account email, with an unsubscribe link. Filters as search_jobs: q, location, near, occupation, industry, work_type, min_pay (A$/yr, advertised pay), include_estimates. Max 5 alerts. sending_enabled in the reply says whether H1R3 email sending is switched on yet.

location.description: state/region code or place, e.g. qld-gold-coast, remote

name: create_job_alert
